I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread to confirm I've noted it: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. (the Thistle work) is due 24 December.

The knowledge brain has already saved his message with his name, the channel and the time, so I didn't need to store it separately. When I searched the brain, it had no earlier date for Thornbury or Thistle that could clash with this one. That search ran on keywords only, so treat that as "nothing found," not proof there's nothing.
